newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends unchanged, forward premia fall.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends unchanged, forward premia fall.

text.p: The Indian rupee ended Friday unchanged at 35.71/72 in listless trade, dealers said.
Dealers said the dollar traded between 35.71 and 35.72 rupees during the day. The Reserve Bank of India bought dollars at 35.725 rupees, a dealer said.

Premia on forward dollars fell on receiving pressure, dealers said. "There are strong rumours of a cut in cash reserve requirements for banks," a dealer said. "Corporates are receiving premia anticipating a fall."
Premia on six-month dollars ended Friday at 9.97 percent annualised from Thursday's close of 10.36, a dealer said.
